PhilosophyPhilosophy

From proprietary trading desk to institutional multi-asset manager.

Timeline

Evolution timeline

  1. 01

    Principal Capital

    Founded in 2022, Cypher Capital built its track record by deploying its own balance-sheet capital first.

  2. 02

    Multi-Strategy Desk

    Expanded into systematic, market-neutral and event-driven strategies across liquid markets.

  3. 03

    Institutional Investment Platform

    Today, Cypher Capital combines institutional asset management with proprietary investment, applying the same capital discipline across both.

T-Shaped Philosophy

Breadth across markets. Depth in each. Held together by one discipline.

  • Institutional Discipline

    Rigorous investment standards applied across every market and strategy.

  • Cross-Market Execution

    Hands-on trading capabilities across traditional venues, digital assets, and specialized alternative platforms.

  • Risk Management

    Liquidity discipline, internal controls and downside protection embedded in every decision.

  • Leadership

    Leadership with operating experience across trading, asset management, private investment and infrastructure.

digital-multi-strategy-fund.description: An actively managed digital-markets hedge fund targeting absolute returns through market-neutral, systematic and thematic strategies, rather than relying on the direction of crypto markets.
digital-multi-strategy-fund.html:
DigitalDigital Multi-Multi- StrategyStrategy FundFund

An actively managed digital-markets hedge fund.

The Fund

Cypher Digital Multi-Strategy Fund is an institutional multi-strategy hedge fund designed to generate absolute returns across digital markets. Its market-neutral, systematic and thematic strategies are built to perform whether digital market prices rise or fall.

Explore access formats
Digital Markets

From digital assets to digital markets

The Fund allocates across three digital markets, each with distinct drivers of return.

  • On-chain Derivatives

    Perpetual markets with the depth of traditional venues, open around the clock.

  • Tokenized RWAs

    Equities, indices and commodities, on-chain and always open.

  • Prediction Markets

    A continuous price on real-world outcomes, from rate decisions to geopolitics.

The Strategies

A multi-strategy approach

The Fund takes a multi-strategy approach to investing across the digital-asset ecosystem, dynamically allocating capital across complementary sources of return.

  • 01

    MarketMarket NeutralNeutral

    Yield, carry, basis and relative-value strategies with limited directional market exposure.

  • 02

    SystematicSystematic

    Data-driven and quantitative strategies that seek to identify repeatable opportunities across liquid digital markets.

  • 03

    ThematicThematic

    High-conviction, low-risk high-return positions on macro shifts and structural trends across the markets.

The Portfolio

Dynamic allocation between strategies

The strategies run within a single portfolio and risk framework, and capital moves between them as market conditions evolve. The result is a diversified return stream with low correlation to market beta.

Contact us

Terms, fund documentation and performance materials are shared exclusively through direct contact.

Engage with Cypher Capital
